faq.question: What Amazon data sources do you use?
faq.answer: We work from Seller Central and Amazon Ads reporting relevant to your account, plus agreed operational inputs such as inventory and launch calendars.

faq.question: How often will I receive reports?
faq.answer: Most accounts follow a weekly operational report and a monthly strategy review. Cadence can be adjusted for catalog size and decision needs.

faq.question: Is this only advertising reporting?
faq.answer: No. Advertising is central, but we also track sales, conversion, and catalog indicators so decisions are not made from ad metrics alone.

faq.question: Can reporting support my internal team?
faq.answer: Yes. Reports are built for shared use by owners, operators, and agency specialists with consistent definitions.

faq.question: Do you build custom dashboards?
faq.answer: We structure reporting around the decisions your team needs. Format and depth are defined during onboarding. We are not a software dashboard product.

faq.question: How does reporting connect to other services?
faq.answer: Insights feed PPC, listing, catalog, and account management work so analysis leads to execution, not static decks.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: We support reporting for accounts selling across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Scope for a specific account is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a metrics-gap review, reporting cadence plan, then ongoing weekly and monthly reviews.
